title: The r-Safety Reserve and Adaptive Kinematic Smoothing for Car-Following Transitions
summary: Longitudinal spacing models describe the speed--spacing states that vehicles maintain, while longitudinal controllers regulate vehicle motion through spacing and speed errors. Less explicit is how one spacing state should be connected to another through a finite, physically meaningful vehicle transition. This paper develops such a connection through r-Safety and Adaptive Kinematic Smoothing (AKS).
